EXTREMELY CARELESS, WILL INJURE YOUR PET - We’ve only gone to this place twice and they’ve cut our dog both times. The first time they cut her private parts. This time they cut her incision site‼️‼️‼️it’s extremely red and irritated and our dog won’t stop licking it. WILL NEVER GO BACK. DO NOT BELIEVE THE HIGH REVIEWS.

Edit in response to owner: you are lying. The service is definitely rushed and you guys clearly don’t care about the wellbeing of the dogs you groom. This is not a one time thing. Our dog was sent back with cuts on her privates the previous time, that the store manager admitted to after I called the studio back. We were not notified when we picked her up both times of her injuries. You clearly do not check.

Pupstudio is the best for my dog Teddy.  They take such great care of him and you can tell they love him so much.  He always comes out perfectly groomed and smelling amazing.   Highly recommend.

Extremely disappointed with the service here. The completely forgot my dog grooming appointment and prioritized another dog instead cause there said have 2 dogs same name ‘ Hudson ‘. They initially told us it would take 3 hours, but the total waiting time stretched to 5 hours.

What annoyed us the most was that they texted us saying our dog was ready for pickup, but when we arrived, we had to wait an extra 2 hours. We wasted so much time driving back and forth. Throughout the whole ordeal, there was zero accountability and no apology whatsoever. Save yourself the headache and go elsewhere. Highly NOT recommended

Have been here for many times this time is unacceptable and disappointing
I literally drive from Queens to get my baby groomed and its always worth the trip. She smells amazing and looks amazing.

Pupstudio has been an amazing experience from start to finish. The team is incredibly friendly, patient, and takes the time to make every dog feel comfortable. My pup came back looking exactly how I hoped, clean, fluffy and beautifully groomed. I'm so happy we found this place. Highly recommend!

I've been bringing my dog Jackson to PupStudio for the past two years, and I honestly haven't had a single bad experience. The groomers always take the time to talk through the haircut with me and make sure they understand exactly what I'm looking for. If they ever have any questions or run into an issue during the groom, they keep me updated, which I really appreciate.

Jackson always comes home looking amazing. I took him to another place near our home and they butchered him. It took forever for his hair to grow back. After two years of consistently great service, I wouldn't trust anyone else with Jackson. Highly recommend!

It's hard to find a grooming salon you can completely trust in NYC, but pupstudio has exceeded my expectations every single time. Highly recommend to anyone looking for quality grooming and exceptional care for your pup!
My pup always comes home looking amazing, smelling great, and most importantly, happy and relaxed. The salon is spotless, the communication is excellent, and the attention to detail is unmatched!
Absolutely love this place! The staff is always welcoming, professional, and genuinely cares about every dog that walks through the door
My pup absolutely loves coming to PupStudio for a spa day! Every time I pick up my little fluffball, they’re so clean, soft, fluffy, and smell amazing. Thank you so much. We couldn’t be happier!
